checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Button (menu item) widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `toggled` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Action.doc: A menu item: plain, a check item (`checkable`) or a radio item (`group`), with an optional `shortcut`. AccessKit role Button, CheckBox or RadioButton.

checkable.doc: A check item: picking it toggles `checked`.

checked.doc: Check or radio state; picking a check item toggles it, picking a radio item sets it.

group.doc: A radio item: the actions of one parent with the same group form an exclusive set; picking one checks it and unchecks the others (each announced).

shortcut.doc: Keyboard accelerator such as `Ctrl+O`, `Ctrl+Shift+S` or `F5`: shown right-aligned and active while the menu's owner (menu-bar, menu-button, context-menu) is drawn. Modifiers: `Ctrl`, `Shift`, `Alt`, `Cmd` (macOS command), `Primary` (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere); keys are egui `Key` names. An unknown key is an error.

activate.doc: The user picked it (click, Enter, or its shortcut); carries `checked` after the pick.
activate.name: activate

toggled.doc: The user changed `checked` (a check item, or a radio item turned on or off by a pick); carries the new state.
toggled.name: toggled

Box.doc: A flexbox container laid out by taffy; draws nothing itself.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

flex-wrap.doc: Whether children wrap onto more lines.

focus-scope.doc: `contain`: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside while focus is in it; `dialog`: also takes focus when it appears (`autofocus` node, else the first) and gives it back to the opener when it goes away.

gap.doc: Space between children on both axes, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

cancel.doc: Escape activates it while focus is in its focus scope (or root).

default.doc: Enter activates it while focus is in its focus scope (or root) and the focused node does not take Enter itself.

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

selected.doc: Drawn as selected (a toggle look); clicking does not change it.

Canvas.doc: A drawing surface replaying the X8 display list (`ops`) that `@svelters/canvas` records, as GTK's and Qt's `canvas` do. Paths fill as simple polygons (no holes, nonzero = even-odd), `clip` cuts to the path's bounding box, `clearRect` paints the window background.

ops.doc: The display list (X8): a JSON array of `[name, ...args]` arrays as `@svelters/canvas` records it. Replayed with egui's painter each frame; no JS runs while it paints.

resize.doc: Its laid-out size changed (and once after the first layout); `draw()` of `@svelters/canvas` records for it.
resize.name: resize

checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Checkbox widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Checkbox.doc: A check box with a caption.

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

open.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::CollapsingHeader (header) + taffy flexbox (body) widget writes open into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

CollapsingHeader.doc: A clickable header with a caret; its children (a flex box, indented) are shown and laid out only while `open`.

open.doc: Shows the children; a click on the header (or Enter/Space on it) toggles it.

text.doc: The header's caption (also its accessible name).

changed.doc: The user opened or closed it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

value.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::color_picker::color_edit_button_hsva widget writes value into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ColorPicker.doc: A colour swatch; clicking it opens egui's colour picker popup.

alpha.doc: Whether the popup edits alpha (`egui::color_picker::Alpha`): `opaque` hides it, `blend` edits it, `blend-or-additive` also offers additive.

value.doc: The colour, CSS hex: `#rrggbb` when opaque, `#rrggbbaa` otherwise (`#rgb`, `#rgba` accepted). Editing it in the popup changes it.

changed.doc: The user edited the colour; carries it (CSS hex, once per frame while dragging).
changed.name: changed

selected.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ComboBox widget writes selected into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ComboBox.doc: A drop-down list: shows the selected option, picks one from a popup. Name it with `accessible-name` (it has no caption).

hint-text.doc: Shown while `selected` is out of range.

options.doc: The choices, in order (the popup's rows).

selected.doc: Index of the chosen option; picking a row changes it. Out of range shows no text.

changed.doc: The user picked a row; carries its index.
changed.name: changed

ContextMenu.doc: A menu that attaches to the element it is declared in and opens at the pointer on a secondary click on it (the innermost owner wins). `popup` opens it below its owner. The shortcuts of its actions are active while the owner is drawn.

popup.doc: Opens it (a context menu below its owner).

value.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui_extras::DatePickerButton widget writes value into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

DatePicker.doc: A button showing a date; clicking it opens a calendar popup (Save/Cancel).

calendar-week.doc: Shows ISO week numbers in the calendar.

format.doc: How the button shows the date (`strftime`, jiff's `civil::Date::strftime`).

value.doc: The date, ISO 8601 (`2026-10-22`); `""` for none (the button shows today). Picking a day and pressing Save changes it.

changed.doc: The user saved a date; carries it (ISO 8601).
changed.name: changed

value.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::DragValue widget writes value into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

DragValue.doc: A number edited by dragging horizontally, the arrow keys, or typing after a click. Name it with `accessible-name` or `tooltip`.

decimals.doc: Decimals shown (`DragValue::fixed_decimals`); null for egui's automatic precision.

value.doc: The value; dragging, the arrow keys or typing change it. Kept within `min` and `max`.

changed.doc: The user changed it; carries the new value.
changed.name: changed

Frame.doc: A flex box drawn inside an egui frame (background, border, rounding, inner margin), with an optional caption.

frame-style.doc: The egui frame drawn around the content: `egui::Frame::group`, `canvas`, `window`, `menu`, `popup`, `side_top_panel` (`panel`), or no chrome (`none`). Its inner margin adds to `padding`.

label.doc: A caption above the content (GTK's `Gtk.Frame:label`); empty for none.

Grid.doc: A CSS grid container laid out by taffy: children fill the cells row by row (auto-placement); draws nothing itself.

align-items.doc: Vertical alignment of each child in its cell.

column-gap.doc: Space between columns in points; null to use `gap`.

gap.doc: Space between rows and between columns, in points (row-gap and column-gap override it).

grid-template-columns.doc: The column tracks, CSS syntax: `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `<n>fr`, `<n>px` (or a bare number: points), `<n>%`, `minmax(a, b)`, `fit-content(<len>)`, `repeat(<n>, tracks)`. Rows are implicit (`auto`). The default is a form: a label column and a field column.

justify-items.doc: Horizontal alignment of each child in its cell.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

row-gap.doc: Space between rows in points; null to use `gap`.

Hyperlink.doc: A link: text that opens `url` when clicked (AccessKit role `Link`).

new-tab.doc: Asks for a new browser tab (`OpenUrl::new_tab`). A middle click always does.

text.doc: The link text; the url when empty.

url.doc: Opened on a click (`Context::open_url`: eframe opens the browser, an embedder reads `PlatformOutput::commands`); empty for none.

clicked.doc: Pressed and released (before the url opens).
clicked.name: clicked

Icon.doc: A glyph from an icon font the embedder registered (SVP6), by name or as text. With `frame` it is an icon button. Its accessible name is `accessible-name`, else `tooltip`, else `name`.

family.doc: The registered font family (`egui::FontFamily::Name`) holding the glyphs; empty for the proportional family. A family with no fonts, a name not in its table or a glyph no font has draws an outlined placeholder box (`svelters_egui::fonts::FontWarning`).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws it as a button (an icon button: role `Button`, takes focus).

glyph.doc: The glyph itself (text), when `name` is empty or not in the table.

name.doc: The glyph's name in the family's name table (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_icons`); also the default accessible name.

selected.doc: With `frame`: drawn as selected (a toggle look).

size.doc: Font size in points; null for the body size.

source.doc: An image instead of the glyph: an `asset://` ref (an imported SVG or PNG), a file path or any uri an egui loader serves. Measured `size` (else the body size) square and fitted inside; when it does not load the placeholder box is drawn.

tint.doc: With `source`: tints the image with the text colour (SVG `currentColor` icons render white, then tint like a glyph); false keeps its own colours.

Image.doc: A picture from `source`, at its own size unless `width`/`height` say otherwise. AccessKit role `Image`, named by `accessible-name` or `tooltip`.

fit.doc: How the image fills its rect (CSS `object-fit`): `contain` keeps the aspect ratio inside it, `cover` fills it and crops, `fill` stretches, `none` keeps the image's size, `scale-down` is the smaller of `none` and `contain`.

source.doc: What to show: a file path, a `file://` uri, or any uri an egui loader serves (`bytes://` from `Context::include_bytes`, `http(s)://` with egui_extras' loaders). PNG decodes built in.

clicked.doc: Pressed and released on it (it senses clicks only while listened).
clicked.name: clicked

open.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Window widget writes open into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

InnerWindow.doc: A floating window inside the viewport (`egui::Window`): movable, optionally resizable, collapsible and closable; its children are a flex box.

closable.doc: Shows a close button in the title bar.

collapsible.doc: The title bar can collapse it to the title.

default-width.doc: Initial width in points (a resizable window's content fills it).

default-x.doc: Initial left edge in points (viewport coordinates); null: egui places it.

default-y.doc: Initial top edge in points (viewport coordinates); null: egui places it.

open.doc: Shown when true; the close button sets it false.

resizable.doc: The user can resize it; the content is laid out at its size. Without it the window is as big as its content.

changed.doc: The user (or `popup`/`popdown`) opened or closed it; carries `open`.
changed.name: changed

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

selectable.doc: The text can be selected and copied.

wrap-mode.doc: What a line longer than the width does (`egui::TextWrapMode`).

Menu.doc: A menu: a menu-bar button, or a submenu row inside another menu. Inside a `menu-button` its items are the button's menu (its label is unused).

label.doc: The title: the menu-bar button, or the submenu row.

MenuBar.doc: A horizontal menu bar of `menu` children (and plain `action`s). One interact row high; it takes no width of its own, so it fills a column (align-items stretch) or needs `flex-grow` in a row. The shortcuts of its actions are active while it is drawn.

active.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::containers::menu::MenuButton widget writes active into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

MenuButton.doc: A button that opens a menu of its children (`action`, `menu`, `menu-separator`; a `menu` child's items are shown inline, as GTK's menu-button takes a menu). The shortcuts of its actions are active while it is drawn.

popup.doc: Opens it (a context menu below its owner).

active.doc: The menu is open; the user opening or closing it changes it, setting it opens or closes it.

changed.doc: The user opened or closed the menu; carries `active`.
changed.name: changed

MenuEntry.doc: Common properties of the menu entries (`menu`, `action`, `menu-separator`, `context-menu`): drawn inside a menu, never laid out by taffy.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name; the label by default.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root (AccessKit author id, `Embed::anchor_rect`).

enabled.doc: Can be picked when true; drawn greyed out otherwise.

visible.doc: Shown in its menu when true.

MenuSeparator.doc: A line between menu items (a vertical one in a menu bar).

open.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Modal widget writes open into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Modal.doc: An in-window modal dialog: a backdrop over the viewport that blocks the rest of the UI, its content centred, sized to fit (or `width`/`height`). The egui form of a modal dialog (no OS-modal windows on egui: EGUI.md §5).

dismissable.doc: Escape or a click on the backdrop closes it; with false only the app does.

open.doc: Shown when true (so `{#if}` alone can show it); the user dismissing it sets it false.

title.doc: A heading above the content; also the dialog's accessible name.

changed.doc: The user (or `popup`/`popdown`) opened or closed it; carries `open`.
changed.name: changed

size.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui panel look (`Visuals::panel_fill`, separator, resize grip) + taffy flexbox widget writes size into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Panel.doc: A side or top/bottom panel: a flex box with the panel background and a separator on its inner edge, optionally resizable. Place it at the edge of a row (left/right) or column (top/bottom).
Panel.native: egui panel look (`Visuals::panel_fill`, separator, resize grip) + taffy flexbox

resizable.doc: The inner edge can be dragged to resize it.

separator.doc: Draws a line on the inner edge.

side.doc: The edge of the parent it belongs to: the separator and the resize grip are on the opposite edge, and `size` is its width (left, right) or height (top, bottom).

size.doc: Width (left, right) or height (top, bottom) in points; null for its content's. Dragging the grip of a `resizable` panel changes it, within `min-*`/`max-*`.

changed.doc: The user resized it; carries the new size.
changed.name: changed

open.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Popup widget writes open into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Popup.doc: A popover anchored to its owner: the element it is declared in (attached), or the box it is placed in. Its children are a flex box sized to their content (or `width`/`height`), out of the owner's flow. GTK's `popover`.

popdown.doc: Closes it (announced like a user close).

popup.doc: Opens it (announced like a user open).

autohide.doc: A click outside closes it; with false only Escape, `popdown` or the app does.

open.doc: Shown when true; the user closing it (Escape, a click outside with `autohide`) sets it false.

placement.doc: The side of its owner it opens on (egui moves it to another side when it does not fit).

changed.doc: The user (or `popup`/`popdown`) opened or closed it; carries `open`.
changed.name: changed

ProgressBar.doc: A horizontal bar filled to `fraction`, as wide as its rect.

animate.doc: Animates the bar and shows a spinner in it (busy look; repaints while shown).

show-percentage.doc: Shows the percentage inside the bar when `text` is empty.

text.doc: Text inside the bar; empty for none.

checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::RadioButton widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

group.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::RadioButton widget writes group into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

RadioButton.doc: One choice of several. Siblings are exclusive: a click checks it and unchecks the other radio buttons of the same parent. Bind `checked` per button, or `group` on every button with a `value` each.

checked.doc: Chosen. A click checks it and unchecks its sibling radio buttons (Qt's auto-exclusive siblings); it never unchecks itself. With `value`, it follows `group == value`.

group.doc: The group's chosen value (`bind:group={choice}` on every button of the group, each with its own `value`). A click sets it on this button and its siblings.

value.doc: What this button stands for in its group: a click writes it into `group`.

changed.doc: The user's click changed it (or a sibling's click unchecked it); carries the new state and group value.
changed.name: changed

high.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::RangeSlider widget writes high into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

low.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::RangeSlider widget writes low into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

RangeSlider.doc: A horizontal slider with two handles selecting `low`..`high`; the handles meet but never cross.

high.doc: The upper end; dragging its handle changes it. Kept within `low` and `max`.

low.doc: The lower end; dragging its handle (or the arrow keys on it) changes it. Kept within `min` and `high`.

show-value.doc: Shows an editable value box at each end.

text.doc: Caption after the slider (each handle is named `<text> low`/`<text> high`).

changed.doc: The user moved a handle (or the widget clamped a written value); carries both ends.
changed.name: changed

drag-started.doc: A drag on the rail began.
drag-started.name: drag-started

drag-stopped.doc: A drag on the rail ended.
drag-stopped.name: drag-stopped

scroll-x.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ScrollArea + taffy flexbox (content) widget writes scroll-x into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

scroll-y.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::ScrollArea + taffy flexbox (content) widget writes scroll-y into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ScrollArea.doc: A flex box whose content scrolls when it overflows the area's size (taffy `overflow: scroll`); give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

direction.doc: The axes that scroll (taffy `overflow: scroll` on them).

scroll-x.doc: Horizontal offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

scroll-y.doc: Vertical offset in points; scrolling changes it, and a write scrolls (clamped to the content).

changed.doc: The user scrolled (or a write was clamped); carries the new offsets.
changed.name: changed

Separator.doc: A thin line between items; fills its rect along its orientation.

orientation.doc: A horizontal line (in a column) or a vertical one (in a row).

Sides.doc: A row with its first child at the start and its second at the end (wrap several items in a `box`); with more children, the space is shared between them.

align-items.doc: Cross-axis alignment of the two sides (`center` is egui's look).

gap.doc: Minimum space between the two sides, in points.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

value.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Slider widget writes value into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Slider.doc: A horizontal slider with an optional value box.

show-value.doc: Shows the value box next to the slider.

value.doc: The value; dragging or the arrow keys change it.

changed.doc: The user moved it; carries the new value.
changed.name: changed

drag-started.doc: A drag on the slider began.
drag-started.name: drag-started

drag-stopped.doc: A drag on the slider ended.
drag-stopped.name: drag-stopped

size.doc: Diameter in points; null for the row height (`interact_size.y`).

spinning.doc: Spins (and repaints while shown); false keeps its space empty.

divider-position.provenance: svelters-egui: the two panes + a draggable divider (egui drag sense) widget writes divider-position into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

SplitView.doc: Two panes (its first two children; more are not shown) split by a divider the user drags. `divider-position` is the first pane's size.
SplitView.native: two panes + a draggable divider (egui drag sense)

divider-position.doc: Size of the first pane in points along the split; null for half. Dragging the divider changes it (`bind:divider-position`); it is clamped by `min-size` when laid out.

min-size.doc: Smallest size of either pane, in points.

orientation.doc: `horizontal`: the panes side by side (a vertical divider); `vertical`: one above the other.

changed.doc: The user dragged the divider; carries the first pane's new size.
changed.name: changed

Stack.doc: Shows one of its children (GTK's `stack`, Qt's `stacked-widget`): the one anchored `visible-child-name`, else the one at `visible-index`. The others are neither drawn nor hit.
Stack.native: synthetic (one child shown at a time)

homogeneous.doc: Sized to the largest child (GTK's `hhomogeneous`/`vhomogeneous`); false: to the visible child.

padding.doc: Inner spacing on all four sides, in points.

visible-child-name.doc: Shows the child whose `anchor` is this name (GTK's `visible-child-name`; the child names itself with `anchor`). Empty: `visible-index` decides.

visible-index.doc: Shows the child at this index when `visible-child-name` is empty or names no child (Qt's `current-index`).

active.provenance: svelters-egui: the synthetic (egui toggle switch, AccessKit role `Switch`) widget writes active into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Switch.doc: An on/off switch with a sliding knob (GTK's `switch`; WinUI's `toggle-switch`).

active.doc: On; a click or Space toggles it.

text.doc: Caption after the switch (also its accessible name).

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

Tab.doc: A page of a `tab-view`: a flex box whose `title` is its tab's caption.

closable.doc: The tab shows a close button (`close-requested`).

title.doc: The tab's caption (also its accessible name).

close-requested.doc: The tab's close button was clicked (or middle click on the tab); remove the tab to close it.
close-requested.name: close-requested

selected.provenance: svelters-egui: the tab bar (egui selectable labels) + the selected page widget writes selected into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

TabView.doc: Pages under a tab bar: each child (a `tab`) is a page titled by its `title`; only the `selected` one is laid out and drawn.
TabView.native: tab bar (egui selectable labels) + the selected page

selected.doc: Index of the shown page; a click on a tab changes it.

changed.doc: The user picked a tab; carries its index.
changed.name: changed

current.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui_table::Table widget writes current into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

current-column.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui_table::Table widget writes current-column into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

selected.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui_table::Table widget writes selected into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

Table.doc: A virtual table (`egui_table`): only the visible rows and columns are drawn. Its children are `table-column`s; its rows are a JS data window (`range` asks, `set-rows` answers), keyed by `set-ids`. Keyboard navigation, type-ahead, keyed selection and cell editing (WG5a). Give it a size or let flex-grow size it.

clear-rows.doc: Drops the data window (every row draws empty until `set-rows`).

edit.doc: `edit(rowId, column)`: starts editing that cell (its column must be `editable`).

end-edit.doc: `end-edit(commit)`: ends the open edit; true commits (`commit`), false reverts.

scroll-to-row.doc: `scroll-to-row(row)`: scrolls the row into view on the next frame.

set-ids.doc: `set-ids(ids, labels?)`: the id of every row by position (and the text type-ahead matches); the row count is then `ids.length`. Selection, cursor and edits follow ids across sorts and filters. null: ids are positions again.

set-rows.doc: `set-rows(first, rows)`: the data window, rows `first..first + rows.length`, each row a list of cell values (strings, numbers, booleans; null for empty). Replaces the previous window.

current.doc: The cursor row's id (keyboard focus inside the table), -1 for none.

current-column.doc: The cursor column (Left/Right move it; F2 and typing edit that cell).

overscan.doc: Rows beyond the visible ones that `range` asks for on each side (data ready before it scrolls into view).

row-count.doc: Number of rows (the scroll extent). Rows without data yet are drawn empty.

row-height.doc: Height of every row (and of the header row), in points.

selected.doc: The selected row ids (`bind:selected`); clicks (Ctrl/Shift with `selection="multi"`) and the keyboard change it. Kept by id across `set-ids` (sorts, filters).

selection.doc: `single`, `multi` (Ctrl/Shift clicks and keys, ranges) or `none` (a cursor only).

sticky-columns.doc: Number of leading columns that do not scroll horizontally.

striped.doc: Alternate rows get a faint background.

activated.doc: A row was double-clicked (a cell of a column that is not `editable`) or Enter pressed on the cursor row; carries its position.
activated.name: activated

changed.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected row ids (`bind:selected`).
changed.name: changed

commit.doc: An edit is committed: row id, column index, the editor's value. Accept by returning nothing; reject with `e.result = 'reason'` (shown under the cell) or `e.preventDefault()`: the cell reverts.
commit.name: commit

header-clicked.doc: A column header was clicked (sort on it in JS and set the column's `sort`).
header-clicked.name: header-clicked

range.doc: The rows the table needs data for changed: `first..=last` (the visible rows plus `overscan`); answer with `set-rows`.
range.name: range

selectionchange.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected row ids.
selectionchange.name: selectionchange

TableColumn.doc: A column of its parent `table` (data only: not laid out or drawn as a node). Its `width` (Widget's, in points; null for 100) is the column's width; a user resize keeps its width until the prop changes.

end-edit.doc: `end-edit(commit)`: ends this column's open edit; true commits, false reverts.

set-editor.doc: Runtime protocol: `set-editor(outlet)`, the realised editor snippet of this column (null drops it).

editable.doc: Its cells can be edited (F2, typing, double click); the editor is `editor`, else a text field.

editor.doc: The cell editor, a snippet taking the edit (`{ row, column, value (bindable), typed, commit(), cancel() }`); realised once and rebound per edit.

resizable.doc: Its right edge can be dragged (double-click: fit the content).

sort.doc: The sort arrow its header shows (the data is sorted by JS).

editor-bind.doc: Runtime protocol: an edit of this column's cell starts (the editor snippet's outlet is `set-editor`).
editor-bind.name: editor-bind

editor-unbind.doc: Runtime protocol: the edit ended; the editor stays realised for the next one.
editor-unbind.name: editor-unbind

editor-value.doc: Runtime protocol: the editor's value to commit (the handler sets `e.result`).
editor-value.name: editor-value

text.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::TextEdit widget writes text into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

TextEdit.doc: A single- or multi-line text field.

request-focus.doc: Moves keyboard focus here on the next frame.

char-limit.doc: Maximum number of characters; 0 for none.

hint-text.doc: Shown while the text is empty; also the default accessible name.

multiline.doc: Several lines (`TextEdit::multiline`); Enter inserts a newline.

text.doc: The edited text; typing changes it.

changed.doc: The user edited the text; carries the new text (once per frame).
changed.name: changed

ToastHost.doc: Shows transient notifications stacked in a corner of its viewport, over everything; takes no space itself. `show` from JS (`bind:this`), `svelters_egui::toast::show` from Rust.

show.doc: `show(text, level = 'info', duration = the host's)`: shows a toast (level: info, success, warning, error; duration in seconds, 0 = until closed) and returns its id.

corner.doc: The viewport corner the toasts stack in.

duration.doc: Seconds a toast stays when `show` gives none; 0 keeps it until closed.

closed.doc: A toast went away: `reason` is `timeout`, `dismissed` (its close button), `method` (`dismiss`/`clear`).
closed.name: closed

checked.provenance: svelters-egui: the egui::Button (selected) widget writes checked into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

ToggleButton.doc: A button that stays pressed (`checked`). With `radio`, a row of them is a segmented control: a click checks one, the app unchecks the rest.

checked.doc: Pressed state; a click toggles it (with `radio`, a click only sets it).

font-weight.doc: CSS font weight (100-900). Drawn with the font family the embedder registered for the nearest weight (`svelters_egui::fonts::register_weight`); 400, or no registered family, draws the regular face.

frame.doc: Draws the button background and border.

radio.doc: One of a segmented group: a click checks it and never unchecks it (`Ui::selectable_value`); AccessKit role `RadioButton`. The app unchecks the others.

changed.doc: The user toggled it; carries the new state.
changed.name: changed

clicked.doc: Pressed and released (also when a `radio` click left it checked).
clicked.name: clicked

TreeView.doc: A virtualized tree: JS keeps the tree and flattens its visible rows into the list; children load when a node expands.

selection.doc: The selected ids, hidden ones included.

setNodes.doc: `setNodes(ids, levels, flags, labels, data)`: the tree facts of rows by id (flags: 1 expandable, 2 expanded; a level < 0 forgets the id).

setRow.doc: `setRow(row, widget)`: the content of row slot `row` (called from `setup`); null clears it.

setSelection.doc: `setSelection(ids)`: replaces the selection (single keeps the first); raises nothing.

splice.doc: `splice(pos, removed, ids)`: replaces `removed` rows at `pos` with `ids` (the visible rows, flattened).

indent.doc: Points per level; the disclosure triangle sits in the last one.

row-drag-type.doc: Non-empty: rows drag, as a payload of this type (their `data`) plus `text/plain` (their labels).

row-drop-types.doc: Non-empty: rows take drops of these types (WG4b patterns) and raise `drop-row`.

row-height.doc: The height a row is assumed to have before it is measured, and its minimum, in points.

selection.doc: `single` or `multi` (Shift ranges, Ctrl toggles); `none`: rows are not selectable.

activate.doc: The user activated the row at `pos` (double click, Enter).
activate.name: activate

bind.doc: Slot `row` now shows item `id` at `pos`; `gen` counts the binds of the slot.
bind.name: bind

collapse.doc: The user collapsed node `id` (disclosure click, Left): splice its children out.
collapse.name: collapse

copy.doc: Ctrl+C on the focused tree: copy the selected rows.
copy.name: copy

drop-row.doc: A drag was dropped `before`, `after` or `into` row `id` (-1: below the last row), as the entry of `type` it took.
drop-row.name: drop-row

expand.doc: The user expanded node `id` (disclosure click, Right): splice its children in.
expand.name: expand

selection-changed.doc: The user changed the selection: read it with `selection()`.
selection-changed.name: selection-changed

setup.doc: Row slot `row` was created: give it content with `setRow`.
setup.name: setup

teardown.doc: Slot `row` is gone: release its widget.
teardown.name: teardown

selected.provenance: svelters-egui: the svelters_egui::kinds::virtuallist (recycled row slots over a VScroll) widget writes selected into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

selected-ids.provenance: svelters-egui: the svelters_egui::kinds::virtuallist (recycled row slots over a VScroll) widget writes selected-ids into the node during the pass; `changed` carries it (arg 0), set_prop never announces

VirtualList.doc: A virtualized list (the M5 model-view protocol): JS keeps the items, the list asks for the rows it shows.

setRow.doc: `setRow(row, widget)`: the content of row slot `row` (called from `setup`); null clears it.

splice.doc: `splice(pos, removed, ids, labels?)`: replaces `removed` ids at `pos` with `ids` (unique integers); `labels` (strings, one per id) are what type-ahead matches.

VirtualList.native: svelters_egui::kinds::virtuallist (recycled row slots over a VScroll)

layout.doc: `list` (egui draws `grid` as a list for now).

row-height.doc: The height a row is assumed to have before it is measured, and its minimum, in points.

selected.doc: The selected position, -1 for none. Setting it never raises `select`.

selected-ids.doc: The selected item ids (`bind:selected-ids`); kept by id across splices, sorts and filters.

selection.doc: `single`: a click or the keyboard selects a row (`select`); `multi`: Ctrl/Shift clicks and keys select several (`selectionchange`); `none`: rows are not selectable.

activate.doc: The user activated the item at `pos` (double click).
activate.name: activate

bind.doc: Slot `row` now shows item `id` at `pos`; `gen` counts the binds of the slot.
bind.name: bind

select.doc: The user selected the item at `pos`.
select.name: select

selectionchange.doc: The user changed the selection; carries the selected ids.
selectionchange.name: selectionchange

setup.doc: Row slot `row` was created: give it content with `setRow`.
setup.name: setup

teardown.doc: Slot `row` is gone: release its widget.
teardown.name: teardown

Widget.doc: Common properties of everything placed in a window: state, tooltip, accessibility and its taffy item style.

accessible-name.doc: AccessKit name (`Response::accessible_name`); inputs default to their hint or text.

align-self.doc: Cross-axis alignment in the parent box, overriding its `align-items`.

anchor.doc: A name unique in its embedded root: the node's egui id derives from it (stable across runs, not only across reorders), it is the AccessKit author id, and `Embed::anchor_rect` finds it. Changing it drops the node's egui memory.

autofocus.doc: Takes keyboard focus when it first appears (in a `dialog` scope: when the dialog opens).

bottom.doc: Inset from the containing block's bottom edge in points; null for auto.

drag-data.doc: The drag payload's data (JSON for structured data); `drop` delivers it.

drag-type.doc: Makes the node a drag source: the payload's type, a MIME-like string (`cad/part`); empty for none.

drop-types.doc: Makes the node a drop target: the drag types it accepts, separated by spaces or commas (`*` any, `cad/*` a prefix); empty for none.

enabled.doc: Takes input when true; drawn greyed out otherwise (`Ui::add_enabled`).

flex-basis.doc: Main-axis size before growing or shrinking; null for auto.

flex-grow.doc: Share of the parent's free main-axis space.

flex-shrink.doc: Share of the parent's main-axis overflow to give up.

height.doc: Height in points; null for auto.

invalid.doc: Marks the value as invalid: an outline in the error colour (`Visuals::error_fg_color`) and AccessKit `invalid`. The app sets it; the widget never does.

left.doc: Inset from the containing block's left edge in points (`position: absolute` or `relative`); null for auto.

margin.doc: Outer spacing on all four sides, in points.

max-height.doc: Maximum height in points; null for none.

max-width.doc: Maximum width in points; null for none.

min-height.doc: Minimum height in points; null for auto.

min-width.doc: Minimum width in points; null for auto.

position.doc: `absolute` takes the node out of the flow and places it by `left`/`top`/`right`/`bottom` inside its containing block: the nearest `relative` or `absolute` ancestor, else the root.

right.doc: Inset from the containing block's right edge in points; null for auto.

top.doc: Inset from the containing block's top edge in points; null for auto.

visible.doc: Shown and laid out when true (`display: none` otherwise).

width.doc: Width in points; null for auto.

animationend.doc: A native animation (TR2) finished; carries its id. The runtime listens to it itself.
animationend.name: animationend

drag-begin.doc: Drag source: the user started dragging this node (`drag-type` set).
drag-begin.name: drag-begin

drag-end.doc: Drag source: the drag ended; `dropped` is true when a target took it.
drag-end.name: drag-end

drag-enter.doc: Drop target: a drag it accepts entered it (`drop-types` set); carries the drag's type.
drag-enter.name: drag-enter

drag-leave.doc: Drop target: the drag left, was cancelled, or was dropped here (before `drop`).
drag-leave.name: drag-leave

drop.doc: Drop target: a drag it accepts was released over it; carries the type, the data and the point in the node's own points.
drop.name: drop

Window.doc: A native window (the root viewport, or an immediate viewport); its children are laid out as a flex column.

close.doc: Closes the window as the user would (no close-request).

present.doc: Shows the window (the first one presented is the root viewport).

gap.doc: Space between the window's children, in points.

padding.doc: Inner spacing of the content area, in points.

close-request.doc: The user asked to close the window; return true to keep it open. Runs before the frame's pass.
close-request.name: close-request

px.provenance: egui points: 1px in a style sheet is one point
